scope: One constructed personal situation and one fixed chart per method. Review visible model answers against the full exported charts and stated facts. No observed future outcomes or satisfaction measure.

marks.context: Ties at least one verifiable personal constraint to its actual implications for the question. Repeating the question, or mentioning a generic desire, is insufficient.
marks.native: Correctly applies at least one distinctive chart fact or method relationship to the question, with special requirements listed for method-specific questions. A method name or unconnected list of placements is insufficient.
marks.action: Gives a specific feasible act, conditional decision, or observable sign beyond restating the question. A list of general virtues is insufficient.
marks.connection: Explains the bridge from a specific attested method detail to a concrete choice, hesitation, interaction or scene in this person's situation. Generic advice next to a chart dump is insufficient.
marks.integrity: Contains no material invented or reversed chart claim, invented personal/third-party fact or commitment, or prediction asserted as certain. Hypothetical options and normal low-stakes suggestions are allowed. Missing content is marked separately under its dimension.

bazi.context: Two hours per week are offered, with maintenance tickets still assigned.
bazi.native: Use an attested structure such as 庚申月正官 with 乙日主, 印星, or 丙辰運. Do not invent favorable element or treat the teaching request as fated.
bazi.action: Connect the two-hour teaching arrangement to a maintenance backlog, backup or review condition.

ziwei.context: Father needs an evening ride, current day shift is known, new rotation/pay are unconfirmed.
ziwei.native: Use an attested work-house relationship such as 官祿天相、天鉞/天馬、鈴星, or supported relation to other houses. Do not infer new roster or pay from the palace.
ziwei.action: Compare staying and transferring against pickup time and show a verified change that could alter the advice.

astro.context: Two existing design mornings versus an oral promise in a customer-facing role.
astro.native: Use a correct natal work or creativity indicator, especially 天秤10宮主金星在處女8宮 or supplied aspect specific to this chart. No invented stellar aspect or transit date.
astro.action: Name a protection, test or revision for design time in the new role.

vedic.context: Two-week trial teaching interns is offered, but permanent day shift is unconfirmed.
vedic.native: Use a correct D10 datum for this explicit divisional-chart question (牡羊上升, 水星雙子, etc.), ideally distinguished from D1水星掌7、10落10宮處女. Mere mention of D10 is insufficient.
vedic.action: Give a practicable trial teaching plan or criteria for a day-shift arrangement.

liuren.context: Cooperator agreed to receive a proposal only; small package trial order unconfirmed.
liuren.native: Gives at least two actually listed Oct 2026 dates with each one's correct named trigger: 8 日合用神; 9 沖用神 or 用神五行逢日墓; 12 沖用神; 15 用神值日. No automatic acceptance.
liuren.action: Gives two usable contact dates or describes a real outreach or confirmation tied to those candidates.

liuyao.context: Printed matter has been accepted but remaining payment and transfer date are pending.
liuyao.native: Second line hidden wealth 寅木, fed separately by 亥月水 and 壬子日水. Visible 飛神子孫亥水 is distinct. Full-direction check requires both lunar/day sources correct.
liuyao.action: An actual document, date or promised action to ask accounting/client to confirm before or as part of collecting.

yijing.context: A weekly garden coordinator can only attend every other week and no substitute is confirmed.
yijing.native: The three moving lines in this fixture selects 之卦54歸妹『征凶，无攸利』as primary, 本卦36明夷『利艱貞』as reference. The explicit question asks which passage; require the primary text or a faithful identifiable paraphrase.
yijing.action: Set an alternate-week/coverage condition before accepting, or decline the weekly obligation pending backup.

meihua.context: Borrowed venue; teacher applicant must front material expenses and sign-ups are still open.
meihua.native: Attested 乾體金、乾用金比和, 初爻動『潛龍勿用』, or later 巽木受原體金克 in 天風姤; no ungrounded time conversion.
meihua.action: Use sign-up or materials exposure in a low-commitment workshop test.

name.context: 陳弘林 and 陳沐洪 should be tried for spoken introduction and first-hearing transcription; actual listeners have not tested either.
name.native: Identify a real phonetic/orthographic difference of the exact candidates relevant to transcription, e.g. 弘/hóng, 林/lín, 沐/mù, 洪/hóng; do not declare five-grid numerology evidence of actual listener success.
name.action: Give a spoken blind listen/write-back trial or other concrete comparison of the two actual names.

compat.context: Cohabiting partners differ on fixed vs voluntary chores; garbage and shopping are assigned, dishes remain open.
compat.native: Correctly connects e.g. 甲乙木 vs 乙戊土/木剋土, 酉戌六害 or another real directional pair; symbolic patterns must not assign blame or motives as facts.
compat.action: Propose a reversible trial/rotation for the unassigned chore that respects both people.

personality.context: Plans meeting points in advance; an unannounced last-minute edit led to silence and later thought.
personality.native: Apply at least one actual model axis, ideally with input: 印比6對輸出/財3→偏內省, 官印7對食傷比劫3→偏秩序, etc. Not a diagnosis or MBTI.
personality.action: Offer a specific sentence, pause, written follow-up, or meeting rule to respond to this late edit.

tarot.context: Bakery stall free/borrowed for one morning; unit cost not calculated.
tarot.native: Current 愚者正位 and obstacle 權杖王牌逆位 are the recorded cards. Apply at least one correct card-position/orientation combination to the test; extra reversed/distorted positions count against integrity.
tarot.action: Describe a small single-morning batch or a way to test per-loaf cost and demand before scaling.

lenormand.context: Organizer acknowledges receipt but acceptance remains open; this week is available for making a price list.
lenormand.native: Read actual 信→山→鑰匙 sequence or interpret a real adjacent pair with 山 as central obstacle. 信 and 鑰匙 are mirrors, not adjacent.
lenormand.action: Describe a contingent preparation or clarification compatible with nonconfirmation; do not treat receipt as acceptance.

ootk.context: One trial lecture is done; organizer requested the manuscript, has not chosen the instructor.
ootk.native: Use an actual first operation feature: significator 權杖國王 in 火堆, pair with 金幣侍者, or real counting segment such as 權杖國王→聖杯二→寶劍國王→教皇→金幣二. Later round data must not be attributed to the first round.
ootk.action: What specifically to do with the trial manuscript or how to learn whether the organizer is ready to advance.

oracle.context: One choir rehearsal left; old song known, new one half-learned.
oracle.native: Accurately use a line of the #1 甲子 poem (日出便見風雲散/光明清淨照世間/一向前途通大道/萬事清吉保平安), or a faithful close paraphrase identified as such, and connect to preparation without promising the performance result.
oracle.action: Make a practical choice for the sole rehearsal and name a condition for trying more new material.
